title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user's private messages without permission | TechCrunch
summary: Meta is fighting back against a journalist’s claim that its AI agent Muse read the user’s private messages without permission. However, Aten’s report claimed that when Muse read his messages, Full Disk Access was off.
